What if you had the bite of a crocodile?
Meet the saltwater crocodile. Up to six meters long.
It has the strongest bite ever measured.
That's like a car pressing down.
But the muscles that open its jaws are weak.
A few wraps of tape can hold them shut!
Its jaws feel touch better than your fingertips.
And each tooth can be replaced about 50 times.
It even swallows stones, maybe to help it dive.
Now you. A normal bite? Crunch, an apple.
A coconut? Crushed in one bite!
Just watch out for your tongue.
So... what would you bite first?
